name: .NET CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Plan explicit category hosts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Plan only the reviewed selection
        id: selection
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/plan-test-ci.ps1 -SelectionFile tests/selection.json -GitHubOutput $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT

  selected-tests:

name: Portable load selected Linux qualification

# Deliberately trigger only an edited filesystem selection or this workflow.
# The repository permits only the three actions referenced below.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/1553-load-filesystem
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/portable-load-linux.yml
      - tests/selections/1553-load-linux.json

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: portable-load-linux-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  selected-filesystem:
    name: Selected load filesystem contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      TESTINGPLATFORM_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: '1'
      DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE: 'false'
      DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT: '1'
      GenerateDocumentationFile: 'true'
      NoWarn: '1591'
